blocks.text: Managing your SEO workflow on Mac

Your day as an SEO specialist is rarely quiet. You start by checking rank trackers for volatility and end by compiling reports that justify your budget. The transition between these tasks is where you lose momentum. Every time you switch from a technical crawl in Screaming Frog to a client email in Gmail, you lose focus. Research shows it takes 23 minutes to refocus after checking an email. That is time you cannot afford to lose.
Where your time goes during the day

You likely spend 36.3 percent of your time on keyword research alone. When you add technical site audits and backlink analysis, your browser becomes a graveyard of open tabs. Using a tool like Lazur helps you stay inside your primary workflow. Instead of clicking through menus to find a specific setting, you ask Lazur to point it out. This keeps your hands on the keyboard and your eyes on the data.
Using seo reporting software help with Lazur

When you need help with your reporting software, you are usually looking for a specific metric or a way to export data. If you use Looker Studio or Google Sheets, the menus can be deep. Hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask, Where is the export button? Lazur draws a circle around the correct element. This is faster than hunting through submenus while on a client call.

If you are working with sensitive client data, ensure you follow your employer's internal security policies regarding data storage and AI usage. Lazur keeps your data local and does not train models on your screen content.

blocks.text: Email is the biggest drain on your productivity. You spend over two hours every day managing correspondence. To cut this down, use the dictate feature in Lazur. Hold the fn key and speak your response. It formats your text at the cursor in any app, whether you are in Mail, Slack, or a web browser. This saves you from typing out the same SEO performance explanations repeatedly.

blocks.text: Native Mac apps like Screaming Frog are powerful but have complex interfaces. When you are deep into a crawl, you do not want to stop to look up a keyboard shortcut. Use Lazur to explain how to navigate the settings. Ask, How do I change the crawl limit? Lazur guides you through the menu path step by step. This allows you to keep your focus on the technical analysis rather than the software interface.

Most SEO reporting happens in Google Sheets. Whether you are building a pivot table or using formulas to clean up keyword lists, you need to be fast. If you struggle with a specific function, ask Lazur to explain it. You can also use [How to count unique values in Google Sheets on Mac](/how-to/count-unique-values-in-google-sheets) to speed up your data cleaning. If you need to organize your view, learn [How to freeze the top row in Google Sheets on Mac](/how-to/freeze-the-top-row-in-google-sheets) to keep your headers visible during long data reviews.

Good reporting is about clarity and speed. If you spend too much time formatting cells, your clients will wait longer for insights. Use [How to merge cells in Google Sheets on Mac](/how-to/merge-cells-in-google-sheets) to create clean headers for your reports. When your report is ready, follow [How to export google sheets as pdf on mac](/how-to/export-as-pdf-in-google-sheets) to prepare the file for your client. Consistency in your reporting routine makes it easier to track progress over time.

faq.question: Can Lazur edit my SEO reports directly?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit files for you. It helps you by pointing out where tools are, explaining how to use them, and dictating text at your cursor.

faq.question: Is Lazur safe to use with client data?
faq.answer: Lazur processes your screen and audio only while you hold the shortcut. The data is not stored or used to train AI models. Always follow your employer's rules regarding client data.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with Windows SEO tools?
faq.answer: Lazur is designed specifically for macOS. If you use Windows tools via virtualization, Lazur may not be able to see or point to elements inside the virtualized environment.
